svg.title: USDe on Avalanche C-Chain by holder, May 15 to October 11, 2026
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of 150 days. The supply of USDe on Avalanche C-Chain rose from 0.187 million on May 15, 2026, the day the first EthenaPay wallets were created, to 10.543 million on October 11. EthenaPay wallets held more than half of it for the first time on September 2, 64.3%, and 56.8% on October 11, 5.985 million. The settlement and reward accounts, which are the settlement addresses, the settlement recipients and the reward accounts together, held 2.910 million more, so accounts tied to EthenaPay held 84.4%. Holders outside EthenaPay held 1.648 million. A dashed line marks the 2025 high of 5.237 million.
svg.text: EthenaPay wallets held 56.8% of the USDe on Avalanche at the end of October 11
USDe on Avalanche C-Chain at the end of each UTC day, May 15 to October 11, 2026, stacked by holder

svg.text: Settlement and reward accounts are the two settlement addresses, the three settlement recipients and the three reward accounts.
Holders outside EthenaPay include the rhino.fi bridge contract and the Uniswap v3 pool. The dashed line marks the 2025 high.
Transfers of USDe on Avalanche C-Chain, read from the Routescan explorer API on October 12, 2026 UTC. Wallets are not people.
